messages:
Alex: Kickoff for CedarWave x EdgeProxy partner launch. Scope: 30m demo + 1 joint how-to + 1 marketplace listing. Target date: 2026-06-25 09:00 PT. Main hook: deploy low-latency LLM inference at the edge with centralized cost controls.

Nora: Love the hook. Audience = platform + ML infra. Recommend we front-load the benchmark results in the landing hero (percent delta) and keep a technical appendix repo.

Ibrahim: CedarWave can provide sanitized throughput metrics and an architecture diagram. Legal needs to approve any numbers; they prefer percent improvements vs "raw p95 ms". Who owns the methods write-up?

Jules: I can draft the methods section and a reproducibility script (small docker + run script). Will aim to deliver draft by Tue EOD.

Pri: Routing / tracking: registration to HubSpot -> SFDC queue "Partners/CedarWave". UTM to use: `utm_source=cedarwave&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=cw-ep-jun25`. Form fields: email, company, role, region, consent. Please standardize so reporting works.

HubSpotBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/cw-ep-jun25. Auto follow-up email configured to include the integration guide and reproducibility repo link.

Alex: For the marketplace listing we need logo (SVG), two screenshots, 120-word blurb, and a 50-word tagline. CedarWave PM said they'll share assets by Fri.

Nora: Promotion plan: 2 partner tweets, 1 joint blog (long-form benchmark narrative), 1 gated how-to on the marketplace listing. Cross-post on LinkedIn and developer forum. Email sends: Redwood list (10k) + CedarWave list (2k).

Ibrahim: On the benchmark visuals: if legal insists on percent only, we'll show relative bar charts and include a link to the appendix for reproducibility steps. Also add a note "results based on internal testbench".

Jules: Snippet I'll include in the blog for reproducibility:
```bash
# quick reproduce (local)
git clone https://github.com/redwood/repro-cw-ep.git
cd repro-cw-ep
./run.sh --model redwood/opt-quant --seq 512 --iters 1000
```

Pri: SFDC mapping: if lead email domain matches cedarwave.ai -> assign to Cedar AE team, otherwise to PartnerOps. I'll add a rule for source=CedarWave. Also set lead_source=partner_marketplace.

Alex: Action items: Jules deliver reproducible repo + methods (Tue), CedarWave deliver assets (Fri), Pri set SFDC rules + HubSpot nurture (Wed), Nora draft promotion calendar and hero copy (Thu). Quick sync Fri 9am PT to confirm assets.

Ibrahim: I'll run a quick internal sanity check on the metrics once I have the CSV. CedarWave will send the redacted CSV to gdrive/partners/cedarwave/benchmarks.csv.

Alex: Nice. Keep the CTAs simple: "Download integration guide" and "Request a demo". We'll A/B test hero CTAs on the landing.

Nora: I'll also prepare a short FAQ for the marketplace listing addressing security, supported runtimes, and pricing model assumptions.

Jules: Noted. I'll include a troubleshooting section in the repo.

Pri: Putting timeline in the shared checklist now. Will post SFDC mapping doc to this thread when done.

Alex: Thanks team, ping me for blockers. :rocket:
